name: scotlis-mcp
description: Search Scottish property sale prices (ScotLIS) by postcode
long_description: Queries ScotLIS (Registers of Scotland's public land register) for every registered title at a UK postcode and returns the sale date, price, and consideration for each. Covers Scotland only, and only titles on the Land Register.

tools.name: search_property_prices
tools.description: Search registered property sale prices in Scotland by postcode
